source: Merchandise exports, Ministry of Commerce (DGCI&S) via https://data.gov.in/ (Open Government Data)
note: SEED pack. `value` is the latest merchandise-export YoY growth (external-demand proxy); refresh from data.gov.in with scripts/refresh_macro.py --kind trade before relying on the magnitude. `neutral` 0 means flat exports map to a zero nudge. `sector_sensitivity` is a maintained crosswalk of export orientation (0..1; NSE-Industry + yfinance) and is never touched by a fetch. tailwind = clamp(((value-neutral)/TRADE_SCALE) * sensitivity, -1, 1). Not investment advice.
